why: In the npx tsc --init file the learner uncommented rootDir and set it to ./src, and typed ./dist into outDir, but left outDir's line commented out ('// "outDir": "./dist",'). tsc ignores it, so npx tsc wrote index.js next to index.ts in src/ (ls src shows both) and there is no dist/ folder. outDir is not set.

step.title: Point tsc at src and dist
step.instructions: In tsconfig.json, uncomment "rootDir" and set it to "./src", and uncomment "outDir" and set it to "./dist". Then run npx tsc: it compiles src/index.ts to dist/index.js.
hints: Lines that start with // in tsconfig.json are comments; tsc skips them.
common_mistakes: Editing the value but leaving the // in front of the line.

files.src/index.ts:
const greeting: string = 'Hello from TypeScript'
console.log(greeting)
